description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractNodeVisitor` within the Twig templating engine, providing a base for visiting nodes in the abstract syntax tree. It facilitates compatibility between different Twig versions and declares abstract methods for entering and leaving nodes.

classes.name: AbstractNodeVisitor
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a common interface and base functionality for node visitors within the Twig templating engine. It ensures compatibility across different Twig versions and defines hooks for processing nodes during traversal.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Final method that delegates to doEnterNode; called when entering a node during traversal.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Final method that delegates to doLeaveNode; called when leaving a node during traversal.

methods.name: doEnterNode
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, invoked before visiting child nodes.

methods.name: doLeaveNode
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, invoked after visiting child nodes.
